note: Edges use existing atlas nodes probability, gaussian and variance.

description.zh: 由杨辉三角数路径得到二项分布 C(n,k)pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ，均值 np、方差 np(1−p)；n 增大时它贴近同均值同标准差的正态曲线，并学习连续性修正。独立、概率固定的二选一模型，近似误差在远尾部较大。
description.en: Counting paths in Pascal’s triangle gives the binomial C(n,k)pᵏ(1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ with mean np and variance np(1−p); as n grows it hugs the normal curve of the same mean and spread, with a continuity correction for tails. Independent two-way trials with fixed p; the approximation is weakest in far tails.

reason.zh: 概率的乘法规则加上路径计数，给出 n 次独立试验恰好成功 k 次的概率。
reason.en: The multiplication rule for probabilities plus path counting gives the chance of exactly k successes in n independent trials.

label.en: Approaches the normal for large n

reason.zh: 二项柱状图在 n 大且 p 不太偏时贴近同均值同标准差的正态曲线，这是正态分布出现的一条最直观途径。
reason.en: For large n and a not-too-lopsided p the binomial bars hug the normal curve with the same mean and spread, one of the most visible routes by which the normal distribution appears.

reason.zh: 二项分布是独立伯努利方差相加的实例：每次方差 p(1−p)，n 次相加得 np(1−p)。
reason.en: The binomial is an instance of independent variances adding: each trial has variance p(1−p), so n trials give np(1−p).

label.zh: 曲线高度就是概率密度

reason.zh: 正态曲线每点的高度是概率密度，曲线下面积等于概率——钟形本身就是一种概率分布的画像。
reason.en: At each point the normal curve's height is a probability density and area under it equals probability — the bell itself is a portrait of a probability distribution.

title.zh: 为什么扔很多次硬币，正面数像一口钟？
title.en: Why does the head count of many coin flips look like a bell?

ask.zh: n 次独立试验恰好 k 次成功的概率怎么算？均值和方差是多少？
ask.en: How do you compute the chance of exactly k successes in n independent trials? What are its mean and variance?

ask.zh: n 增大时，二项柱状图贴近什么样的曲线？“同均值同标准差”是什么意思？
ask.en: As n grows, what curve do the binomial bars hug? What does “same mean and same spread” mean?

ask.zh: 钟形曲线的高度代表什么？曲线下的面积为什么等于概率？
ask.en: What does the height of the bell curve stand for? Why does area under the curve equal probability?

reveal.zh: 由杨辉三角数路径得到二项分布，均值 np、方差 np(1−p)。n 增大时它贴近同均值同标准差的正态曲线，连续性修正补上离散与连续的缝隙。
reveal.en: Counting paths in Pascal's triangle gives the binomial with mean np and variance np(1−p). As n grows it hugs the normal curve of the same mean and spread, with a continuity correction bridging the discrete-to-continuous gap.
